name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Integrated Rehabilitation Centre For Addicts (IRCA) For Providing Rehabilitation Services To Alcoholics And Drug Users
nodalDept: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
targetBeneficiaries: Institutions working in the field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse
Individuals working in the field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse
briefDescription: This central scheme offers national awards to institutions and individuals demonstrating outstanding services in preventing alcoholism and substance abuse, promoting rehabilitation efforts.
descriptionMd: The National Awards for Outstanding Services in the field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse is a Central scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. It aims to recognize and honor the exemplary contributions of both institutions and individuals dedicated to combating alcoholism and substance abuse. The scheme encourages best practices in prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation, ultimately fostering a healthier society.
benefitsMd:
*   National recognition for outstanding services.
*   Acknowledgement of exemplary work in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse.
*   Promotion of best practices in rehabilitation and treatment.
eligibilityMd:
*   Applicants must be institutions.
*   Applicants must be individuals.
*   Applicants (both institutions and individuals) must be actively working in the field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
